steps.content: The Legion's convoy drives deep into WhiteSands. The Syndicate girl curls up in the backseat, already dreaming.
A diary lies open on her lap, covered in scribbles and corrections, yet each word is written with utmost seriousness.

To <color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>:

Hey big dummy! You're always nagging me, but when I finally call, you don't pick up? Hmph, do you even know how much fun you missed out on?!

I'll let you in on a secret: not only did I survive three days alone in WhiteSands, but I also fought off loads of desert bandits and Nirvana lackeys! Big hero Hella saved an entire village all by herself!

Actually, saying that I did it all by myself isn't quite right. The townsfolk helped me a lot! Even though they come off as kinda weird, they're actually quite decent people!
Of course, it'd be better if they tricked me a bit less!

By the way, didn't you say that if I got stronger, you'd praise me?
And Hecate too! Both of you have to praise me!

Just wait, when I return as a hero, I'll be stronger than anyone from the Legion, the city council, or Paradeisos! By then, with me watching your backs, let's see who in DisCity dares to mess with us!

Alright, this letter's about done. Horo and I are still on the road. Any more writing and I'll get carsick.
When I go back home, I'll tell you all about this one!

From the cutest, most awesome super girl in the world,
<color=#fb9259>Hella</color>
